## Checklist

- [ ] I opened the link and it works without a login.
- [ ] The URL is canonical, with no trailing slash.
- [ ] The link has no affiliate code or tracking parameters.
- [ ] The entry follows the format: `- [Name](https://url) - Description.`
- [ ] The description starts with a capital letter, ends with a full stop, and does not repeat the name.
- [ ] It is not already in the list.
- [ ] A new section, if any, is added to Contents with an intro note.
